purpose: Define the mathematical meaning, geometry, clocks, event tree and invariants required before any new predictive formula.

supersession_on_approval.scope: Pending-order semantics and premature multinomial baseline selection only.
supersession_on_approval.preserved: Pre-trade clock, signed log geometry, data blocking, traceability and production isolation.

geometry.volatility_normalization: z_tp=tp_log_distance/sigma_H; z_sl=sl_log_distance/sigma_H; finite sigma_H>0 must represent an approved log-return volatility scale matched to the exact horizon. M3 approves its data and M4 its estimator.

event_tree.stage_1: entry_executed_by_expiry vs no_entry; for an ideal market entry the semantic baseline is entry probability 1.
event_tree.clock: All stages share the absolute expiry fixed at analysis_at.
event_tree.execution_boundary: Touch, trigger and confirmed fill must be defined by the future execution contract; they cannot be conflated silently.

ambiguity_and_censoring.ambiguous: Both barriers appear in the same observation and their order cannot be reconstructed.
ambiguity_and_censoring.censored: Coverage ends, data are missing, or manual closure occurs before a reconstructable terminal event.
ambiguity_and_censoring.policy: Record both states; never force them into TP, SL, expiry or no_entry.

entry_distribution.meaning: Execution means the entry event defined by the approved execution contract occurred before the fixed expiry.

labels.tp_first: Probabilidad de alcanzar TP antes que SL
labels.sl_first: Probabilidad de alcanzar SL antes que TP
labels.unresolved: Probabilidad de no resolver el plan

invariants.requirement: analysis_at is time zero; every predictive datum and model cutoff must be <= analysis_at, and no later outcome may alter the original snapshot.
A concrete horizon_seconds inside one of the three current profiles is mandatory; expiry_at=analysis_at+horizon_seconds.
invariants.acceptance: No categorical-only or 3-60h fallback is accepted.

invariants.requirement: Long requires SL<entry<TP; short requires TP<entry<SL; invalid geometry blocks the analysis.
invariants.acceptance: Both inequalities are checked before any signal.

invariants.requirement: TP and SL distances are positive signed log distances and are side-symmetric.
Barrier distances must also be expressed in units of an approved positive log-return volatility scale matched to the exact horizon; an unavailable or invalid scale blocks probability.
invariants.acceptance: z_tp=d_tp/sigma_H and z_sl=d_sl/sigma_H with finite sigma_H>0; M3 must approve its data and M4 its estimator before use.

invariants.requirement: Pending entry execution is a separate event. no_entry cannot be renamed as range or expiry_after_entry.
invariants.acceptance: P(entry)+P(no_entry)=1 and both remain visible in the trace.

invariants.requirement: For pending plans the clock never restarts at entry; late entry has only expiry_at-entry_at remaining.
invariants.acceptance: expiry_at is fixed once at analysis_at.

invariants.requirement: Conditional on executed entry, TP_first, SL_first and expiry_after_entry are mutually exclusive and exhaustive.
Overall pending outcomes are TP_first, SL_first, expiry_after_entry and no_entry.
The two main displayed percentages are unconditional P(TP_first) and P(SL_first) from analysis_at; unresolved is explicit.
With snapshot, entry, SL and horizon fixed, moving TP farther cannot increase P(TP_first) and must affect reachability.
invariants.acceptance: Property test over supported sides, pairs and horizons.

invariants.requirement: With snapshot, entry, TP and horizon fixed, moving SL farther cannot increase P(SL_first) and must affect reachability.
invariants.acceptance: Property test over supported sides, pairs and horizons.

invariants.requirement: With all non-time inputs fixed, extending the horizon cannot increase unresolved probability.
An infinitesimal continuous input change cannot create a material probability jump unless a documented discrete market event changes state.
invariants.acceptance: The 5-point price/entry jump of 872/873 is forbidden.

invariants.requirement: Mirrored long and short plans with mirrored signed market inputs must produce mirrored geometry and equivalent reachability.
Market path probability, entry execution, costs, plan quality and account risk remain separate before an explicit integration.
invariants.acceptance: Margin/leverage/cost policy cannot silently change market path probability.

invariants.requirement: Missing, stale, future, invalid or unapproved mandatory data produces blocked or insufficient_evidence, never neutral evidence.
A later observation that cannot order TP and SL is ambiguous; missing coverage or manual closure is censored.
invariants.acceptance: Ambiguous/censored cases remain recorded but are not forced into an outcome.

invariants.requirement: Every output records semantic version, plan, clock, geometry, entry tree, conditional and overall masses, data cutoff and blocking reasons.
invariants.acceptance: The visible explanation is generated from this trace.

accepted_in_m2.detail: Pending no-entry must remain separate from expiry after entry.
accepted_in_m2.effect: Integrated into the two-stage event tree.

accepted_in_m2.detail: Invalid horizons and missing data must block instead of falling back silently.

deferred_without_authorization.detail: Purged splits, embargo and unseen assets.
Account fees, depth impact and funding periods.

discarded_or_not_adopted.detail: Retain current score rules as features.
discarded_or_not_adopted.reason: Only raw data or newly defined transformations may survive; current thresholds and points remain unauthorized.

discarded_or_not_adopted.detail: Treat HyperPerps as an official Hyperliquid heatmap.
discarded_or_not_adopted.reason: Provider and venue scope must remain distinct.
